title: Connector starter: label station, dropship and inventory sync on a store preview
description: Three runnable Private App connectors (label station, multi-supplier dropship, inventory/WMS sync) against in-process mocks of their outside systems, run end to end on a store's preview stage with env=test installs and synthetic orders. Includes a preflight doctor, a test-order helper wrapping tot app test-order, and a webhook server verifying RFC 9421 signatures through vendored connector-kit.
